plannedDescription: No tool functionality is available yet. No input is collected.
emptyToolsDescription: Tools will appear here as this category takes shape.
homeDescription: A collection of lightweight, privacy-first utilities that run directly in your browser.
privacyNote: Local by design. Private by default.
directoryDescription: Choose a category to explore its tools and availability.
resourceEntryDescription: Explore the separate directory of destinations outside Web Box.
notFoundDescription: We couldn’t find the page you’re looking for.
footerDescription: Simple tools. Local processing. Privacy first.
aboutDescription: Web Box is a lightweight, privacy-first collection of utilities for everyday work.
aboutProgress: Browse seven categories of planned browser utilities. Each tool is clearly marked with its availability; the current examples are not functional tools yet.
aboutBrowser: No account is required. This directory uses local metadata and does not depend on an external API.
privacyDescription: Privacy is part of the foundation of Web Box.
networkDescription: The hosting provider receives normal requests when delivering the site and its local fonts. Web Box includes no analytics or tracking scripts. External sites have their own privacy policies; links are clearly identified and open without access to this window.
storageDescription: Your theme and language preferences are saved separately in localStorage under “web-box-theme” and “web-box:language”. No tool input, files, or results are stored or uploaded by this application.
choiceDescription: Your device appearance is followed until you toggle the theme. Language defaults to English until you choose another language. Clear this site’s browser storage to remove saved preferences.
metaDescription: Web Box is a lightweight, privacy-first collection of browser utilities and external resources.
